analysis_set.span: Safety was assessed in the population that included all the patients who had received a dose of tocilizumab or placebo, according to the trial agent that was first received.

follow_up.span: In the safety population, adverse events were reported in 77.3% of 295 patients in the tocilizumab group and in 81.1% of 143 patients in the placebo group through day 28 (<xref rid="t3" ref-type="table">Table 3</xref>); serious adverse events were reported in 34.9% and 38.5%, respectively.

entry_age.span: we enrolled adults (≥18 years of age) with severe Covid-19 pneumonia,

notes: The served SAE counts use the safety population grouped by first agent received; the served mITT label is incorrect. Follow-up is through day 28. Entry criteria describe a subset of hospitalised adults with COVID-19, with no population outside the question.
